thread:
elaine: Noticing a cluster-wide spike in OOMKills on nodes with mixed gpu types in europe-west1, started ~08:10 UTC. Multiple small pods evicted, training pods Pending.

diego: Saw it. `kubectl get events` shows rapid evictions with reason "Evicted: Pods must be killed to reclaim memory" and scheduler failing to binpack because of strict anti-affinity on label `gpu.family`.

aditya: Heap: nodes labeled `gpu.family=t4` and `gpu.family=v100` but some nodes also have `gpu.shared=true` which triggers scheduler to avoid packing. A recent policy update changed requiredDuringScheduling to preferredDuringScheduling for `gpu.shared` but some CRs still require it.

elaine: So fragmentation + memory pressure. Two levers: reduce strict anti-affinity on a subset of queued jobs or drain low-priority cache pods to free memory.

diego: Can we run a descheduler to co-locate low-memory-footprint pods onto fewer nodes to free whole nodes? That should reduce OOMs.

aditya: Descheduler is risky mid-eviction. Alternative: mark a set of nodes `gpu.reserve=true` and move non-gpu cache pods off them; then scale up one small nodepool to soak pending jobs.

ops-bot: scheduled: descheduler dry-run report generated (job id 82). Found 14 nodes with <20% free memory eligible for coalescing.

elaine: Do dry-run first. If it looks good, run descheduler with maxEvict 10 per minute. Also prepare a small on-demand scale (2 n1-standard-16 + 1 gpu node) if scheduling doesn't improve.

aditya: Running dry-run now. Output: descheduler would evict 46 low-priority pods and free ~120Gi memory across 6 nodes. Seems promising.

diego: Approve actual run if we throttle evictions. oncall?

oncall: Approve controlled descheduler run (max 5 evictions/min) for 15m. If OOMKill rate doesn't drop in 10m, rollback.

ops-bot: descheduler started with maxEvict=5/min.

elaine: Eviction rate stable, pending pods scheduling into freed nodes. OOMKills dropping. Pending down from 60 -> 12.

aditya: After stabilization, we'll change affinity rules for the offending CRs to prefer rather than require `gpu.shared=false`. Also add a scheduling test in CI for mixed gpu families.

diego: Filing follow-up: consider node labeling hygiene and a small headroom reservation for memory to avoid oscillation during descheduler runs.

elaine: Thanks, will monitor for 30m and then restore descheduler replicas to previous cadence.
